context_requirements: Active MMP expression and matrix-remodeling or invasion program
Mesenchymal or invasive phenotype with high MMP14/MMP2
Low baseline dependence on matrix-derived survival signals
Functional apoptotic machinery for secondary cell death
falsifiers: No change in MMP1, MMP2, MMP14, TIMP2, CD44, or COL1A1 at 6 or 24 h
Strong proliferation_down or apoptosis signature at 6 h in all lines
No difference between high-MMP invasive lines (A549, PC3, HT29) and low-MMP lines (MCF7, HEPG2)
Clear HIF target induction (e.g., VEGFA, SLC2A1) at 6 h

evidence.supports: MMP inhibitor BiPS can activate HIF and induce HIF target genes, a possible off-target transcriptional effect
MMP inhibition with GM6001 reduces osteoblast survival and bone formation, supporting context-dependent apoptosis/proliferation effects
MMP inhibitor batimastat enhances IFN-gamma-induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in an ovarian cancer model

changes: Removed MMP1 and MMP2 from proximal_up: inhibiting MMPs should not directly increase MMP1/MMP2 transcription; these are not justified as proximal up.
Removed MMP1 and MMP2 from late_up for the same reason.
Removed CD44 from proximal_down and late_down because CD44 also appears in the corresponding up lists; a gene cannot be both up and down at the same time.
Kept CD44 in proximal_up and late_up as a plausible compensatory/adhesion response, but removed the contradictory down entries.
Removed generic proliferation genes CCND1, MYC, PCNA, TOP2A, BIRC5, AURKA, AURKB, CDK1, CCNB1 from late_down because they are generic proliferation markers rather than proximal MMP-inhibitor targets.
Kept generic_effects proliferation_down, g1_arrest, apoptosis as secondary/context-dependent effects, not proximal transcriptional targets.
Kept kinetics slow and magnitude weak at 6 h / moderate at 24 h, consistent with indirect matrix-remodeling and survival effects.
Kept line_response as stated; no abstract provided contradicts the relative high/low MMP invasive line assignments.
Kept all three evidence citations because their abstracts support the stated claims about HIF activation, context-dependent survival, and enhanced apoptosis.
